Years of living with diabetes leave your smallest blood vessels stiff and narrow. Blood can no longer reach your nerves properly, so your toes and fingers are starved of oxygen, and they turn cold and numb.

The capsaicin in cayenne helps those tiny capillaries relax and open up again. Blood can flow freely back to your feet and fingers, and the warmth and feeling start to return.

texts.original: So why are your feet still cold, numb and burning at night?

Because years of high blood sugar stiffen and narrow the tiny blood vessels that feed your feet. Your number can look perfect while those vessels stay half closed, and the nerves in your toes slowly starve for oxygen.

Capsaicin from high-Scoville cayenne helps those small vessels relax and open again, and beetroot gives your body the nitrates it turns into nitric oxide. So blood can travel all the way down to your toes again.

Sound familiar? That's because pain-killers pills never touched the narrowed and stiff blood vessels.

They just calm down the over-active nerves so that they transmit fewer pain signals to the brain. And every day you rely on them the veins only get narrower.

Just Jenny helps those tiny capillaries relax and open up again and restores blood flow exactly where you need it.
